Grading and policies

Six assignments
60%
Midterm (Weeks 1–7)
15%
Final (cumulative)
15%
Weekly concept checks
10%

Exams allow one page of notes. Concept checks are graded for completion.

Assignment grading

Checkpoint 20%, final 80%. The final is graded on correctness (~50%), performance (~20%), and analysis (~30%); performance credit requires correct code. D3 and T3 end with a ten-minute code walkthrough with staff.

Late work

Five slip days per semester, at most two per submission. Reference outputs are released 48 hours after each deadline; nothing is accepted after that. Cluster outages near a deadline move the deadline.

Collaboration and AI tools

Discuss freely; write your own code and analysis; every assignment is individual. You may use AI to explain concepts, read documentation, and debug, but not to write the parts a handout assigns to you. Cite AI use, including prompts.

Help and accommodations

Behind? Start the next stage from a reference output. Recitation and office hours cover tools and concepts. For accommodations, register with the Disability Resource Center and talk with an instructor early. The Rice Honor Code applies.
